subject: af-post
title: AF.POST.------ALT.F.
description: Chart on book p. 131 (T(AF)M-35). AF-POST (affinity postulation) is the subject; ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) and LK-IMP (linkage implications). From ALT-C-PG: AF-CON (affinity convergence). From LK-IMP: C-CONT (composite continuance) and WO-MTH (world methodology). From C-CONT: POL-DY (political dynamics) and DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism). From POL-DY: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From WO-MTH: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). From DYM-F: VT-S (vibrational science). The page text speaks of "what alternative functionalism means in the essence lining of black invention".
